title: Affidavit Details Fake Court Sites: “.gov or .org”

lines.say: Only dot gov is official. The postal inspector says three court-imitating sites changed the banner to say dot gov or dot org.
lines.show: Only .gov is official. The postal inspector says three court-imitating sites changed the banner to say .gov or .org.

lines.say: The real banner says a dot gov website belongs to an official government organization. The affidavit says the imitation sites added dot org.
The affidavit says three sites copied the U.S. Courts website. The courts' administrative office says they are not official.
